postconditions.description: The output list f contains exactly n-1 integers.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i] <= 10**6 for i in range(n - 1))
postconditions.description: Each integer in the output list f is between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(is_consistent(a, b, g, f) for a, b, g in passenger_questions)
postconditions.description: The output list f is consistent with all passenger questions.
If there are no passenger questions, any output is acceptable.
If there are passenger questions, an output must exist.

invariants.expression: all(a != b for a, b in railway_sections)
invariants.description: No railway section connects a station to itself.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in railway_sections)
invariants.description: All stations are numbered from 1 to n.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in passenger_questions)
invariants.description: All departure and arrival stations are numbered from 1 to n.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= g <= 10**6 for _, _, g in passenger_questions)
invariants.description: All minimum scenery beauty values are between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.
